vertical_benchmark.benchmark_source: Brand AI Readiness Audit — 10-site live benchmark (2026-09-12)

findings.title: No machine-readable freshness signals present — AI treats content as undated
findings.evidence: 0/5 freshness signal layers found (HTTP Last-Modified, JSON-LD dateModified, OG article:modified_time, visible 'Last updated', meta date tag). AI defaults to treating undated content as stale. Lureon: 76% of citations go to content updated within 30 days.

suggested_action.summary: Add at minimum: JSON-LD dateModified, HTTP Last-Modified header, and visible 'Last updated: [Date]' text.

findings.research_lift: +47% citation lift for fresh, multi-layer dated content (AuthorityTech 2026)

findings.title: No OpenGraph tags on homepage
findings.evidence: og:title, og:description, og:image all absent from homepage.

suggested_action.summary: Add og:title, og:description, og:image, og:type to every page template.

findings.title: No direct answer in first 80 words (/)
findings.evidence: First 80 words: "Start now Contact sales..."

suggested_action.summary: Open the page with a clear, self-contained statement of what the brand/product does.

findings.title: Statistics without source citations on /
findings.evidence: 10 uncited stats, 0 cited. Princeton KDD 2024: sourced stats → +40% AI citation.

suggested_action.summary: Add source links or parenthetical citations to every statistic.

findings.title: No HTML tables on / — missing highest-citation format
findings.evidence: Zero <table> elements found. Bigeye Agency + TryProfound: HTML data tables → +400% citation probability vs. prose. Comparison pages with semantic tables achieve 67% citation rate — highest single format ever measured.

suggested_action.summary: Add a comparison or data table (with <th> headers, ≥3 rows) to key content pages, especially feature/pricing/comparison pages.

findings.research_lift: +400% citation probability with data tables (Bigeye Agency + TryProfound, 2026)

findings.title: Low answer-capsule ratio (0%) on /
findings.evidence: 0/5 H2/H3 sections have a 40+ word direct answer capsule. ChatGPT citation correlation: 72.4% of cited pages have ≥50%.

suggested_action.summary: Add a direct 40–60 word answer paragraph immediately after each major H2/H3 heading.

findings.research_lift: 72.4% of ChatGPT-cited pages have ≥50% answer capsule ratio (Cognism, 2026)

findings.title: Low Brand Authority Score (23/100) — weak AI trust signals
findings.evidence: Brand Authority Score: 23/100. Weak dimensions: reddit, review_platforms, social_profiles, wikidata.

suggested_action.summary: Prioritize: reddit, review_platforms — these dimensions have the most room for improvement in brand authority.

findings.title: No Organization schema detected
findings.evidence: No Organization, Corporation, or LocalBusiness @type found in JSON-LD.

suggested_action.summary: Add Organization JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs to every page.

platform_fix_code.code: Add JSON-LD Organization schema to your homepage <head> section.

findings.title: No RSL 1.0 machine-readable license declaration
findings.evidence: /.well-known/rsl.json returns 404 and no <link rel='robots-standard-license'> in HTML.

suggested_action.summary: Deploy /.well-known/rsl.json with RSL 1.0 to declare content reuse terms for AI crawlers.

findings.title: Zero AI discovery endpoints present (0/14 checked)
findings.evidence: None of 14 AI discovery endpoints return HTTP 200.

suggested_action.summary: Deploy /.well-known/ai.txt and /ai/summary.json as minimum viable AI discovery.

findings.title: Private/admin URLs exposed in llms.txt (5 found)
findings.evidence: Admin or private paths in llms.txt: https://stripe.com/payments/checkout, https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout. These expose private infrastructure to AI crawlers.

suggested_action.summary: Remove /admin, /account, /checkout and similar private paths from llms.txt immediately.

findings.title: Low question-format heading ratio (7%) on /
findings.evidence: 2/30 H2/H3s are questions. Sample: ['what's happening', 'how leading retailers unify customer experiences and drive growth.']

suggested_action.summary: Rewrite key H2 headings as questions to improve FAQ schema eligibility and AI direct-answer targeting.

findings.title: No visible content freshness date marker on /
findings.evidence: No visible 'As of [date]' or 'Last updated' text marker found. Visible date text is the most human-readable of the 5 freshness signal layers.

suggested_action.summary: Add 'Last updated: [Month Year]' visible text near the top of content pages.

findings.title: No review platform links from homepage
findings.evidence: No G2, Capterra, Trustpilot, or other review platform links detected.

suggested_action.summary: Add G2/Trustpilot badges. SE Ranking 2026: review links → 3× citation probability.

findings.title: 30 images missing alt text
findings.evidence: Images without alt attributes: https://images.stripeassets.com/fzn2n1nzq965/115d4Vd5LVAsqFGDR1ClAv/0ceb2c44a7a7, https://images.stripeassets.com/fzn2n1nzq965/vYmk6v8n7oDAwbDpwhjV6/846f9b3e21454, https://images.stripeassets.com/fzn2n1nzq965/m9HBEK464p46FeNIhs2PV/f5054a93c8a0a...

suggested_action.summary: Add descriptive alt text to all images. Alt text is an AI-indexable content signal.

findings.title: No RSS/Atom feed found
findings.evidence: Checked /feed, /rss.xml, /atom.xml, /feed.xml — all returned non-200.

suggested_action.summary: Create an RSS/Atom feed. Perplexity and AI news agents index feeds for freshness.

findings.title: llms.txt fails spec validation (2 issues)
findings.evidence: File size 63KB exceeds 50KB limit; Private/admin URLs exposed in llms.txt

suggested_action.summary: Fix llms.txt spec violations: ensure H1 present, use absolute links, verify no broken URLs.

findings.title: No Speakable schema
findings.evidence: site_has_speakable=False. No SpeakableSpecification markup found.

suggested_action.summary: Add Speakable schema to product descriptions and key content sections.

findings.title: Multiple H1 headings (2) on homepage
findings.evidence: h1_count=2. Multiple H1s dilute topical authority signal.

suggested_action.summary: Reduce to exactly one H1 per page.

findings.title: Last-Modified HTTP header absent
findings.evidence: No Last-Modified header in homepage HTTP response. Perplexity uses Last-Modified as primary freshness signal.

suggested_action.summary: Configure web server to emit Last-Modified header with accurate file modification date.

findings.research_lift: Last-Modified present → +22% Perplexity freshness score (Ahrefs AI Indexing Guide 2026)

findings.title: No key-takeaway / TL;DR box on /
findings.evidence: No TL;DR, summary, or key-highlight block detected.

suggested_action.summary: Add a 'Key highlights' box near top of content pages.

findings.title: Weak Reddit brand presence
findings.evidence: No dedicated subreddit found, fewer than 3 organic mentions in Reddit search. Reddit is a top-cited source for Perplexity and ChatGPT.

suggested_action.summary: Engage authentically in relevant Reddit communities. A brand subreddit with r/{brand} > 500 subscribers boosts trust signals.

findings.research_lift: Reddit mentions → +19% Perplexity citation probability (Profound AI, 2026)

findings.title: No Twitter Card meta tags
findings.evidence: No twitter:card, twitter:title, or twitter:description found.

suggested_action.summary: Add twitter:card=summary_large_image and twitter:title/description.

findings.title: No llms-full.txt companion file
findings.evidence: /llms-full.txt returns 404.

suggested_action.summary: Create /llms-full.txt with complete product documentation for LLM ingestion.

findings.title: IndexNow not implemented
findings.evidence: No IndexNow key found in HTML or robots.txt.

suggested_action.summary: Implement IndexNow to notify Bing/Perplexity on publish.

findings.title: No machine-readable alternate content links (RSL-006)
findings.evidence: No <link rel='alternate' type='text/markdown'> or text/plain found. AutoGEO ICLR 2026: pages with machine-readable alternates have 2.1× higher RAG retrieval rate.

suggested_action.summary: Add <link rel='alternate' type='text/markdown' href='/page.md'> to key content pages.

findings.title: No WebMCP agentic readiness signals
findings.evidence: /.well-known/mcp.json, /.well-known/webmcp, and /.well-known/agents.json all absent. No MCP card or agent tool HTML attributes detected.

suggested_action.summary: Deploy /.well-known/mcp.json with brand MCP card for Lighthouse 13.3.0+ agentic audits.
